title: The End of Han Feng
summary: Having taken Protector Xuan's power, Han Feng is now about a Five-Star Dou Zong. The Little Fairy Doctor insists on holding him off with her poison, though her Woeful Poison Body is close to breaking out, so Xiao Yan can merge his Lotus Flame. Xiao Yan then drives Han Feng back with it, and the Little Fairy Doctor tells him she is happier at his side than alone in the Chu Yun Empire. Han Feng gives up most of his soul to flee, but he is poisoned with Blood Corrosion and Xiao Yan catches what is left, and Han Feng begs his martial brother for mercy. Old Ying Shan apologizes, and Xiao Yan gives Chief Mo the cure for his son. Zi Yan sniffs out the Old Ground Demon Ghost's hidden vault, which holds the Flame Creation Skill, the Sky Demon Puppet method and a Rank Seven Fire-Attribute monster core. Tian Huo Zun Zhe thanks Xiao Yan, and Xiao Li rushes in to say something has happened to the Little Fairy Doctor.
events: Han Feng reaches about Five-Star Dou Zong with Protector Xuan's power.
The Little Fairy Doctor fights Han Feng to buy time despite the risk to her poison body.
Xiao Yan strikes Han Feng with his merged Lotus Flame.
Han Feng flees with a fragment of his soul, is poisoned, and Xiao Yan catches it; Han Feng begs for mercy.
Old Ying Shan apologizes and Chief Mo receives the cure for Mo Ya.
Zi Yan finds the Old Ground Demon Ghost's vault behind a spatial barrier.
Xiao Yan obtains the Flame Creation Skill, the Sky Demon Puppet and a Rank Seven monster core.
Tian Huo Zun Zhe thanks Xiao Yan; Xiao Li warns that the Little Fairy Doctor is in trouble.
